# Mikeu.Dev

> Portfolio and technical blog of Riki Ruswandi (Mikeu), a software engineer focused on GIS: WebGIS, spatial data, and map-based systems for government and enterprise. Based in Purwakarta, Indonesia. Also builds ERP modules and AI-augmented tooling (RAG pipelines, computer vision).

The site is bilingual: Indonesian is the default (`/`), English lives under `/en/`. Project codes such as "L-01" refer to project "layers" on the map-themed homepage.

## Main Pages

- [Beranda / Home](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/): Overview with featured project layers, capabilities, career timeline, and latest blog posts. English: https://www.mikeudev.my.id/en/
- [Proyek / Projects](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/projects): Portfolio of GIS, ERP, and web projects, including Geovara (GeoJSON editor), Satu Peta Kabupaten Purwakarta, and the Jatiluhur irrigation management unit system.
- [Blog](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/blog): Notes on web development, GIS, and AI.
- [Jejak / Footprints](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/world): Hex-grid world map (Equal Earth projection) of where the site's visitors come from, each drawn back to Purwakarta.
- [Tentang / About](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/about): Background, experience, and skills.
- [Kontak / Contact](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/contact): How to get in touch for projects or collaboration.

## Featured Projects

- [Geovara](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/projects/geo-draw): Web-based GeoJSON editor for drawing and editing spatial data. Live app: https://geovara.vercel.app

## Expertise

- GIS & WebGIS: vector tiles, spatial data processing, map-based dashboards for government and enterprise
- Full-stack web: Laravel/PHP, SvelteKit, React, TypeScript, Node.js
- Databases & infrastructure: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, CI/CD
- AI integration: RAG pipelines, computer vision (YOLOv8, PaddleOCR)
